tagline: Authentic handmade rural Self-Help Group goods delivered directly to your doorstep

labels.ai_estimate_disclaimer: *This rate is an algorithmic regional estimate based on seasonal APMC ranges. Final price is set directly by the SHG.
labels.mic_fallback_hint: If mic fails or is muted, use the large keypad below
labels.photo_ethics_note: Ethical Photo Policy: This studio sharpens low-light rural smartphone photos and clarifies packaging shadows without altering the genuine product shape, colors, or label.
labels.payment_mode: Transparent Payment: Cash on Delivery or Test Escrow UPI. No bank transfer claimed until integrated.

speech_prompts.ask_product: What product are you listing today? Speak product name. (e.g., Spicy Mango Pickle or Organic Turmeric)
speech_prompts.ask_price: What is the selling price in rupees? Speak like 'पन्नास' (50), 'दीडशे' (150) or 'दोनशे वीस' (220).
speech_prompts.confirm_product: You said: {item}, price {price} rupees. Is this correct? Say 'Yes' or 'No'.
speech_prompts.saved_success: Congratulations! Your product is now successfully listed in Bachat Gat Bazaar.
speech_prompts.rejected: Listing cancelled. Let us start again from the beginning.
speech_prompts.help_shop: In this catalog you can order authentic handmade products crafted by rural women Self Help Groups. Tap the speaker icon to listen to item details.
speech_prompts.help_register: Here you can register your SHG products using your voice. Press the large red mic button, speak product name and price, then say 'Yes' to confirm.
speech_prompts.help_studio: This is AI Magic Studio. Enhance smartphone photos taken in dim rural light with auto shadow-lifting and sharpness without altering real labels.
